name: Zaraapelta
sum: Zaraapelta is a medium-sized ankylosaurid from the Barun Goyot Formation of Mongolia, known from a single skull.
holotype: MPC D-100/1388, a skull about 40 cm long without the premaxillae — Barun Goyot Formation, Hermiin Tsav, Gobi Desert, found in 2000.
biology: Known from one skull; no behavioural data.
author: Arbour et al. 2014

sources.text: Arbour, V.M.; Currie, P.J.; Badamgarav, D. 2014. The ankylosaurid dinosaurs of the Upper Cretaceous Baruungoyot and Nemegt formations of Mongolia. Zoological Journal of the Linnean Society 172(3): 631–652. doi:10.1111/zoj.12185
